summary: ACDT #65：bal-devnet-2 定于 1 月下旬，加入 EIP-8024、EIP-7708 ETH 转账日志与 EIP-7778 无退款区块 gas 计算，可能加入 EIP-7843；BPO3 按当前用量不急。VitalikButerin 提出后量子环境下用递归 STARK 聚合内存池对象以节省带宽。VitalikButerin 发文称以太坊本身必须通过 walkaway test。

items.title: ACDT #65
items.note: 21:00，据 Ethereal news #7：BPO3 按当前用量不急，且需要所有共识层客户端实现 getBlobV3 与部分 cell 消息；bal-devnet-2 目标 1 月下旬，加入 EIP-8024 SWAPN、DUPN 与 EXCHANGE，EIP-7708 ETH 转账发出日志，EIP-7778 无退款区块 gas 计算，可能加入 EIP-7843 SLOTNUM；bal-devnet-3 计划再加四项；ePBS 讨论出价最低增幅、提款与分叉时 builder 接入。
items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #7: BPO3 is not urgent at current usage and needs getBlobV3 plus partial cell messages in every consensus client; bal-devnet-2 targets late January with EIP-8024 SWAPN, DUPN and EXCHANGE, EIP-7708 ETH transfers emitting a log, EIP-7778 block gas accounting without refunds and maybe EIP-7843 SLOTNUM; bal-devnet-3 plans four more; ePBS discussed minimum bid increments, withdrawals and builder onboarding at the fork.

items.title: ethresear.ch：基于递归 STARK 的带宽高效内存池
items.note: （vbuterin）17:15：大量用户对象都需广播给最终 builder，在后量子环境下椭圆曲线 SNARK 不可用，文章用递归 STARK 聚合以节省带宽。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Recursive STARK based bandwidth efficient mempool
items.note_en: (vbuterin), 17:15: many user objects must be broadcast to a final builder, and with elliptic curve SNARKs unusable after quantum, the post aggregates them with recursive STARKs to save bandwidth.

summary_en: ACDT #65: bal-devnet-2 targets late January with EIP-8024, EIP-7708 ETH transfer logs and EIP-7778 block gas accounting without refunds, maybe EIP-7843; BPO3 is not urgent at current usage. VitalikButerin proposed aggregating mempool objects with recursive STARKs to save bandwidth in a post-quantum setting. VitalikButerin wrote that Ethereum itself must pass the walkaway test.
